sources.title: Node.js child_process
sources.evidenceSummary: Official docs describe spawn, execFile, fork, timeout, maxBuffer, and shell behavior for subprocesses.
sources.decisionImpact: Future sidecar process launch policy requires no shell strings, explicit executable and argv, bounded timeout, bounded output, and scrubbed environment.
sources.securityCaveat: Phase 44G does not use subprocess execution; optional no-op remains skipped by policy.

sources.title: Node.js worker_threads
sources.evidenceSummary: Official docs describe worker threads as useful for CPU-intensive JavaScript and distinct from child processes.
sources.decisionImpact: Worker threads are future execution evidence only and do not approve worker or sidecar execution in Phase 44G.
sources.securityCaveat: Shared-memory and worker execution remain blocked until a later explicit execution phase.

sources.title: Electron IPC
sources.evidenceSummary: Official Electron docs describe IPC as the bridge between main and renderer processes.
sources.decisionImpact: Future Electron handoff must use a narrow main-process bridge; this repo does not add Electron in Phase 44G.
sources.securityCaveat: No Electron runtime or renderer Node access is introduced.

sources.title: Electron context isolation
sources.evidenceSummary: Official Electron docs describe context isolation as a security boundary for preload APIs.
sources.decisionImpact: Any future desktop bridge must require context isolation and narrow preload APIs.
sources.securityCaveat: No desktop shell is added in Phase 44G.
